verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Thoropass publishes a live llms.txt at help.thoropass.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured, link-indexed table of contents for the help center. Its content, such as framework-to-Unified-Control mapping guides, is directly ingestible by an agent, and help articles are also served as .md URLs. missing for 10: an llms-full.txt or agent-specific docs covering API/MCP usage beyond the help center, first-party documentation describing the llms.txt for agent use, independent hands-on reports of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Use this guide to identify a Unified Control by its corresponding HIPAA framework control.
